quests.title: Wanmin Fresh

dialogue.sit: Sorry, I'm busy at the moment.

dialogue.t: Sure. Just need to think of some other person who can get it there...
Be careful out there in the Guyun Stone Forest. Mind you don't get attacked by some ill-starred thing.

dialogue.section: Deliver the food to Curious Zi'rui

dialogue.t: Why isn't the food here yet? It's been ages...

dialogue.sit: I heard that someone placed a custom order...

dialogue.t: That's right. That boy Zi'rui ordered some Lotus Seed and Bird Egg Soup from us. As I recall, he should be off wandering in the Guyun Stone Forest right about now.
So many young people, all headed out to that weird place — what is Liyue coming to nowadays?
Whatever the case may be, could I trouble you to deliver this meal to him? Just don't fly about too much, or the soup'll spill out.
Thank you so much! I'll head back to Liyue Harbor once I finish eating.

quests.description: Wanmin Restaurant has taken a custom order that now awaits delivery...
